model: same infinite-product BK formula; no fitted offset or new term
height_aggregation: equal mean of production-window ordinate quantiles 0.1, 0.5, 0.9
empirical: exact continuous anchors for stored dyadic smooth unfolding, plus propagated ordinate/unfolding bound
primary_diagnostic: residual divided by nominal ten-block standard error; descriptive, not a calibrated simultaneous hypothesis test
numerical_target: full model plus empirical deterministic bound below 1e-6

secondary_uncertainty_diagnostic.method: overlapping batch means of the variance influence, integrate all batch origins
secondary_uncertainty_diagnostic.status: descriptive sensitivity, not a calibrated simultaneous test

unfolding_evaluation: same smooth unfolding, evaluated in Arb and centered before binary64 rounding; ordinate propagation bounds retained
